prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 123px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable unit 135px · widest one-line content 135px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable unit 43px · widest one-line content 78px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable unit 54px · widest one-line content 135px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable unit 46px · widest one-line content 1145px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). At 360px some words cannot fit unsplit. Horizontal scrolling is ALLOWED: the table may be wider than 360px (column widths summing to more than 359px) (the reader scrolls), or you may fit within 359px and accept the consequences. Fitting and scrolling layouts are judged as two separate classes; propose good layouts of BOTH kinds.
Rendering convention: a full render shows the WHOLE table; anything right of the dashed box is not clipped — it is reached by scrolling. Where a layout scrolls, an extra "viewport view" image shows only what is visible at first sight.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"提供常用化学试剂的识别、规格和储存条件，供查阅与管理使用。","tasks":["按名称查找试剂并核对分子式和 CAS 号","比较试剂的纯度规格","查阅对应试剂的储存条件"],"relations":["每行的名称、分子式、CAS 号、纯度和储存条件属于同一种试剂","名称是主要查找入口；分子式和 CAS 号用于确认身份；纯度和储存条件分别说明规格与保管要求"],"roles":["表头标识五种字段，名称列在功能上充当行标识","每个数据行代表一种试剂，整行信息需要能够对应阅读","储存条件列承载较长说明，其余列以短名称、标识符和规格为主"],"keep_whole":["化学分子式及其下标、数字、水合物连接符应尽量保持完整","CAS 号应尽量保持完整，避免在连字符或数字中间断开","纯度中的百分数、比较符和数值应尽量保持完整","试剂名称应尽量保持完整"],"may_wrap":["储存条件中的说明文字可按自然语义断行","纯度描述可在等级名称与数值规格之间换行","较长试剂名称在空间不足时可按词义换行"],"same_scale":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号都是识别字段，但宽度应依据各自内容而非强制相等","各行相同字段应保持一致的列宽和阅读位置；长说明列可明显宽于标识列"],"h_vs_v":"手机视口内展示五列会迫使长分子式等不可断开的内容拆分，并使储存说明产生大量短行；允许横向滚动可保住标识符并改善说明的行长，但读者需要滚动才能查看右侧字段。"}

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d3r2A","good":"名称、分子式和 CAS 号基本都能在首屏核对；长分子式和 CAS 号保持完整。储存说明的行长较从容，表格高度是四个方案中最小的。","problems":"长试剂名称分两行，纯度和储存条件需要横向滚动查看；首屏右缘露出一小部分纯度列，阅读不完整。说明列撑高行后，左侧短字段下方留白较多。","cause":"名称列 90px 容不下最长名称；前三列合计 345px，纯度列恰好被视口边缘截开。储存列 400px 改善了说明阅读，但增加了横向滚动距离。"},{"design":"d3r2B","good":"五列同屏，储存说明在适配视口的两个方案中较易连续阅读，表格也较短。","problems":"名称、CAS 号、分子式和纯度数值频繁断开，部分化学下标孤立；储存文字仍被切成很短的行，导致行高很大、跨列对应困难。","cause":"名称、分子式、CAS 号和纯度列分别仅 50、65、64、65px；储存列 115px 也只能容纳很短的文字行。"},{"design":"d3r0C","good":"分子式和 CAS 号完整，首屏能看到三个识别字段；比 d3r2A 减少了横向滚动距离。","problems":"最长名称仍然换行，且断在不理想的位置；储存说明变窄后多数行更高，左侧留白更明显。纯度与储存条件仍在首屏之外。","cause":"名称列 105px 仍不足以容纳最长名称；储存列从 400px 缩至 350px，增加了说明的行数。前三列合计 360px，刚好占满视口。"},{"design":"d3r0A","good":"五列同屏，名称和分子式表头完整，名称列较 d3r2B 宽。","problems":"CAS 号、长分子式和纯度数值被拆开；储存说明极窄，形成漫长的竖向文字带，行与行之间难以比较，整体高度最大。","cause":"储存列仅 99px，正文可用宽度约 78px；分子式和 CAS 号列分别只有 70px 和 65px，无法保持标识符完整。"}],"best":["d3r2A","d3r2B"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[144,156,99,100,400],"change":"滚动方案：名称列扩至可容纳最长名称，保留完整分子式和 CAS 号，以及较舒适的储存说明行长；代价是首屏看不全 CAS 号，需滚动核对。"},{"widths":[80,156,99,90,320],"change":"滚动方案：压缩名称、纯度和储存列，使三个识别字段完整出现在首屏，并减少横向滚动；检验更紧凑的说明列是否仍有可接受的行长与行高。"},{"widths":[50,65,55,60,129],"change":"适配视口方案：将更多宽度分配给占主要行高的储存说明，减轻短行和纵向拉长；接受识别字段与纯度仍会拆分，检验这一取舍是否改善整体查阅。"}]}
